children: Las Vegas, Nevada and Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - September 3, 2026) - Body and Mind Inc.

") is pleased to announce that it has received US$2.5 million in contingent proceeds outlined in the Ohio equity interest transaction, which it had previously disclosed in a news release dated July 24, 2023.
The proceeds will be utilized for debt repayment, ongoing litigation in Arkansas, and for general corporate purposes.
